`zygisk.hpp` is the unmodified public Zygisk API v4 header from
[topjohnwu/zygisk-module-sample](https://github.com/topjohnwu/zygisk-module-sample/blob/7bb941ac8edfcffd1d23761e401c45ca95409dc1/module/jni/zygisk.hpp).
Its ISC license is included in the header. API v4 is compatible with the lab's Magisk 27.
